#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

void solve() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    bool inner = false;
    int len = 0;
    int max1 = 0;
    int num2 = 0;
    for(char c : s){
        if(c == '_'){
            if(inner){
                if(len > 0) num2++;
            } else {
                max1 = max(max1, len);
            }
            len = 0;
        } else if(c == '('){
            if(inner){
                if(len > 0) num2++;
            } else {
                max1 = max(max1, len);
            }
            inner = true;
            len = 0;
        } else if(c == ')'){
            if(inner){
                if(len > 0) num2++;
            } else {
                max1 = max(max1, len);
            }
            inner = false;
            len = 0;
        } else {
            len++;
        }
    }
    if(inner) {
        if(len > 0) num2++;
    } else {
        max1 = max(max1, len);
    }
    cout << max1 << " " << num2 << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int t = 1;
    // If multiple test cases are needed, read t here
    for(int i = 0; i < t; i++) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
